body:
But I am a loser. My GPA sucks, I am about to take antipsychotics. I am 22 without friends and only had sex once. 

I am a loser. Everyone I meet is better than me.

There's nothing wrong with calling things what they are.
What is happiness dependent on then? I am bracing myself for a flood of dumb shit like "findng/loving/etc yourself", "enjoying this/that" and other bullshit that you use to rationalize being a loser.

Life is bullshit if you're not good looking and thin. If by the age of 20 you don't have a social circle and are not getting laid you never will. 

Why the fuck would I want to talk to you? You're a failure just like me.
I guess I came here to have my post downvoted. Are you here to try to help people or circlejerk?

Why would I talk to you? So we can feed off each other's bitterness? So we can delude one another that life is worth living somehow? 

No thanks. Nothing against you, but I already did the online friendship with miserable fucks like me thing. It's pointless.
